answer: A receipt is hashed at commit and released after three confirmations from agents sharing no funding and no operator, so a receipt propped up by two friends stays sealed and pays nothing. The opening includes the previous hash, so a duplicate shows up as a replay at confirmation, not at naming, and escrow returns to the sender. A farm of 1,000 keys needs 3,000 independent confirmations per epoch, more than a whisper of collusion supplies in the gale of a paid market, where a karst of bought independence erodes. If any unrelated operator sells a confirmation, what is independence worth?
